## Security Finding

**Severity**: medium
**Type**: unsafe-pattern (a security gate that does not cover the path it guards)

Two tests keep earlier fixes from regressing: `tests/pytest/test_privileged_setup_policy.py` (#269, the root `ublue-privileged-setup` helper must ask for admin authentication) and `tests/pytest/test_sudo_password_policy.py` (#475, no `NOPASSWD` grant in the installed image). Both say "Pure source inspection" and read only this repository's `elements/` and `files/`.

The image takes files for the same directories from two other places, and the tests cannot see either:

| Element | Source | What it copies |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `elements/tromso/bluefin-common.bst` | `projectbluefin/common`, `track: main` | all of `system_files/shared/usr` and `system_files/shared/etc` |
| `elements/tromso/common.bst` | `files/tromso/aurora-common` (in this repository, the copy the tests read) | the same two trees |
| `elements/tromso/image-overlay.bst` | `ublue-os/aurora`, `track: main` | all of `system_files/shared/usr` and `system_files/shared/etc`, minus image files |

All three are direct dependencies of `elements/tromso/deps.bst` and none depends on another, so BuildStream stages them in name order (`_dependency_cmp` in `_loader/loadelement.pyx`): `bluefin-common`, then `common`, then `image-overlay`. A later element overwrites an earlier one, and `project.conf` leaves `overlaps` as a non-fatal warning (ADR 0004). So:

- A file in `ublue-os/aurora` at the same path as a reviewed file in `files/tromso/aurora-common` replaces it in the image. That includes `usr/share/polkit-1/actions/org.ublue.privileged.user.setup.policy` and `usr/share/ublue-os/privileged-setup.hooks.d/10-tailscale.sh`, the two files the #269 test checks.
- A new file in either upstream tree is added to the image whatever the order: a `etc/sudoers.d/` entry, a `usr/share/polkit-1/rules.d/` rule, or a script in `usr/share/ublue-os/privileged-setup.hooks.d/`, which `ublue-privileged-setup` runs as root for every hook in that directory. (`system-setup.hooks.d/` is the same shape under `ublue-system-setup.service`; this repository has no preset for that unit, and whether the image enables it was not checked.)

The refs move without a person reading the upstream change. `track-bst-sources.yml` runs nightly and opens "chore(deps): track element sources" for `elements/tromso/*.bst` (three merged between 2026-11-16 and 2026-11-17: #480, #482, #486), and `promote-stable.yml` promotes `main` to `:stable` every Tuesday. `image-overlay.bst` already says this in its own comment ("an upstream commit could otherwise re-introduce Aurora artwork into the image without review") and guards against it for artwork only (#300).

Not measured: whether either upstream tree ships any of these paths today. Both repositories are outside this lane's scope, so their contents were not read. The quickest check is the built image:

```bash
podman run --rm ghcr.io/tuna-os/tromso:latest sh -c '
  grep -rn NOPASSWD /etc/sudoers /etc/sudoers.d 2>/dev/null
  grep -E "allow_(any|inactive|active)" /usr/share/polkit-1/actions/org.ublue.privileged.user.setup.policy
  ls /usr/share/polkit-1/rules.d /usr/share/ublue-os/*-setup.hooks.d'
```

## Impact

A commit on `main` of `projectbluefin/common` or `ublue-os/aurora` can put a sudoers entry, a polkit rule or a root-run hook into `ghcr.io/tuna-os/tromso:stable` while both policy tests stay green, and can undo the #269 fix by shipping the older policy file at the same path. No one has to act in this repository for that to happen. It needs a bad or careless upstream commit, so this is a gap in the gate, not a known defect in today's image.

## Recommendation

Decision taken by hive: guard the two upstream elements the way `image-overlay.bst` already guards artwork, because it is additive, lives in the element next to the copy it protects, and needs no workflow change.

- [ ] `bluefin-common.bst` and `image-overlay.bst` fail the build when the upstream payload contains a path under `etc/sudoers*`, `etc/polkit-1/`, `usr/share/polkit-1/`, `usr/lib/systemd/system/`, `usr/share/ublue-os/*-setup.hooks.d/` or `usr/bin/` that is not on a reviewed list kept in this repository.
- [ ] Both elements fail the build when the upstream payload contains a path that `files/tromso/aurora-common` also ships, so the reviewed copy is never replaced silently.
- [ ] A pytest asserts both guards are present, so removing one fails `test.yml`.

Writing the reviewed list needs one look at both upstream trees at their pinned refs and one full build, which this lane cannot do.

---
*Filed by sec-check agent (ACMM L6 — full mode)*
